# Mohammed Saif

> Mohammed Saif (also: imohdsaif, mohammedsaif001, mohammed001saif) is a Senior Software Engineer based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India, open to immediate joining. He builds full-stack products and GenAI features: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Azure OpenAI, RAG, MCP and AI agents, mostly on Microsoft D365 Commerce. Studied at Presidency University, Bengaluru.
